LESSON: SOUND ENVIRONMENT

Grade: PP2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: NATURAL 3.5 Soil By the end of the sub-strand, • Learners be guided to 1. How do
Topic 3.6: SOUND ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about SOUND ENVIRONMENT. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. talk about sounds produced in the immediate environment,
2. respond to different sounds in the environment appropriately. different sounds from different technological device 147 musical instruments to produce sounds related to sounds in the environment education warning sounds

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. talk about sounds produced in the immediate environment,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to talk about sounds produced in the immediate environment,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. respond to different sounds in the environment appropriately. different sounds from different technological device 147 musical instruments to produce sounds related to sounds in the environment education warning sounds
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to respond to different sounds in the environment appropriately. different sounds from different technological device 147 musical instruments to produce sounds related to sounds in the environment education warning sounds. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about SOUND ENVIRONMENT.
2. Explain SOUND ENVIRONMENT to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand SOUND ENVIRONMENT.
4. Show that you can: talk about sounds produced in the immediate environment,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about SOUND ENVIRONMENT. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is SOUND ENVIRONMENT important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. talk about sounds produced in the immediate environment,
2. respond to different sounds in the environment appropriately. different sounds from different technological device 147 musical instruments to produce sounds related to sounds in the environment education warning sounds

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
